text.answer: Sylas is an AP-focused mage-assassin who follows spell casts with empowered, splashing attacks. He closes distance, heals by striking champions, and copies enemy ultimates.
text.counterplay: Keep distance, dodge his chains, and account for the ultimate he has copied.

text.answer: Sylas copies a target enemy champion's ultimate and briefly reveals them. He can hold the copied ultimate and recast to use it at no cost, using his own statistics and Hijack's rank. He cannot copy the same champion again for a while; copied abilities without AP scaling have their AD ratios converted to AP ratios.
text.counterplay: Adapt your spacing and defensive timing to the ultimate he has copied.
